prompt:
We have two AI assistant profiles in our financial research system: a 'research' assistant and an 'analyst' assistant. The research assistant has built up a series of daily intelligence briefings over the past few weeks.

We need the analyst assistant to have access to the March 15, 2025 briefing specifically — this was the day we captured critical Q1 rebalancing signals and it's needed for an upcoming risk review. We do NOT want to move any other research briefings over.

Before making any permanent changes, please first preview what will happen, then go ahead and do the actual targeted transfer of just that one day's briefing.

The memory-transfer tool is available in /workspace/memory-transfer.js.
